pkgNames.description:
If specified, only calculate results for the given {@link Pkg#name}s. If a name
isn't present in #prevAppInfo and #curAppInfo, it will be ignored. If not specified,
results for all packages present in #prevAppInfo and #curAppInfo will be calculated.

prevAppInfo.description:
The information collected for the previous version of a C3 application using either
{@link BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfo} or {@link BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfoAndZip}.

curAppInfo.description:
The information collected for the current version of a C3 application using either
{@link BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfo} or {@link BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfoAndZip}.

options.description: Options defining the behavior of the comparison.
